data.title: Prophet's Mosque Imam Emphasizes Sincere Repentance, Seeking Forgiveness in Friday Sermon
data.content:
Madinah, November 20, 2026, SPA -- In his Friday sermon at the Prophet's Mosque, Imam Sheikh Salah Al-Budair advised Muslims to fear Allah, turn to Him in repentance, and remain steadfast in righteousness, explaining that rectifying shortcomings and abandoning sins are signs of divine guidance and success.
    Sheikh Al-Budair noted that seeking forgiveness was the constant practice of the prophets and the righteous, serving as a key to sustenance and blessings and providing security against suffering and distress. Highlighting the vastness of Allah's mercy and pardon, he emphasized that the door to repentance remains open regardless of the gravity of one's sins, provided the individual upholds pure monotheism and avoids associating partners with Allah.
    He concluded by stressing that sincere repentance requires genuine remorse and a firm resolve never to return to sin, warning against merely uttering words of forgiveness while the heart persists in wrongdoing.
    -- SPA
